hooks.text: 只带改装吸尘器的清洁机器人，要一路下潜地核把被拖近太阳的星球“打扫”归位
hooks.excerpt: You are a small, unassuming cleaning bot that desires nothing more than a neat and tidy home. But ever since the planet was dragged closer to the sun by a monomaniacal tech nerd, dust and death swirl across the surface, making for a very messy situation. If your house will ever be clean again, you need to fix the world.
